connector.name: DataLink
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for secure database access (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite)
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-datalink. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the pilat account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: DATALINK_ANALYTICS_URL
env.description: Database connection URL. Pattern: DATALINK_<NAME>_URL where <NAME> identifies the database. Supports postgresql://, mysql://, or file path for SQLite.

env.name: DATALINK_ANALYTICS_READONLY
env.description: Set to 'true' for read-only access. Pattern: DATALINK_<NAME>_READONLY
